mapper.select: SELECT t.fnd10_book_id AS book_id , t.fnd10_item_cd AS item_code , t.fnd10_note AS note , t.fnd10_eval_amt AS eval_amt FROM ( SELECT a.* , f_ast_class_tree_nm_allpath2(b.ast01_class_tree_id) AS fnd10_item_full_nm FROM fnd10_book a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON a.fnd10_ast_class_tree_id = b.ast01_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND fnd10_fund_code_id = #{fundCodeId} AND fnd10_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd10_std_date = #{stdDate} ) t ORDER BY t.fnd10_item_full_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY fnd10_fund_cd) AS book_id , fnd10_fund_cd AS fund_code , fnd10_fund_nm AS fund_name FROM ( SELECT distinct c.fund_cd AS fnd10_fund_cd , c.fund_nm AS fnd10_fund_nm FROM fnd10_book a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON a.fnd10_ast_class_tree_id = b.ast01_class_tree_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT fnd01_fund_code_id fund_id , fnd01_fund_cd fund_cd , fnd02_fund_nm fund_nm FROM fnd01_fund_code fnd01 , fnd02_fund_info fnd02 , fnd08_org_auth fnd08 WHERE fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd02_fund_code_id AND fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd08_fund_code_id AND fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' AND fnd08_org_code_id = #{orgId} AND (fnd02_fund_code_id, fnd02_work_date) IN ( SELECT a.fnd02_fund_code_id, MAX(a.fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info a WHERE a.fnd02_work_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) GROUP BY a.fnd02_fund_code_id ) AND fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(fnd01_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND COALESCE(fnd01_plan_yn,'false') = 'false' ) c ON a.fnd10_fund_code_id = c.fund_id WHERE 1=1 AND fnd10_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd10_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} AND fnd10_std_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) a ORDER BY fnd10_fund_cd

SELECT row_number() over(order by fnd10_item_cd) AS book_id , fnd10_item_cd AS item_code , com50_item_nm AS item_name FROM ( /*----------- 운용펀드 보유종목 -----------*/ SELECT fnd10_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM fnd10_book WHERE fnd10_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd10_std_date = #{stdDate}::date AND fnd10_item_group_cd = '3' --(3:주식) AND fnd10_market_cd != 'B' --(B:비상장) UNION ALL SELECT fnd11_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd11_std_date) FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_std_date <= #{stdDate}::date ) AND fnd11_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) UNION ALL SELECT flt09_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM flt09_fund_item WHERE flt09_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt09_std_date = #{stdDate}::date AND flt09_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) /*----------- 일임/자문 보유종목 -----------*/ UNION ALL SELECT adv10_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM adv10_book WHERE adv10_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv10_std_date = #{stdDate}::date AND adv10_item_group_cd = '3' --(3:주식) AND adv10_market_cd != 'B' --(B:비상장) UNION ALL SELECT adv11_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(adv11_std_date) FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_std_date <= #{stdDate}::date ) AND adv11_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) /*----------- 고유자산 보유종목 -----------*/ UNION ALL SELECT com50_item_cd AS fnd10_item_cd FROM ast09_book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN com50_item ON com50_item_short_cd = ast01_isin AND com50_item_type = '2010' WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_qty != 0 AND ast01_asset_type = '1' /*(1:고유자산)*/ AND ast01_item_s_class_cd IN ('201010','201011') /*(201010:상장주식/201011:IPO)*/ AND (ast09_ast_class_tree_id ,ast09_keep_account_id ,ast09_hold_date ) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id , ast09_keep_account_id , MAX(ast09_hold_date) FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_date <= #{stdDate}::date GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN com50_item ON ( com50_item_cd = fnd10_item_cd AND com50_item_type = '2010' ) WHERE CONCAT(fnd10_item_cd, com50_item_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} GROUP BY fnd10_item_cd, com50_item_nm

SELECT row_number() over(order by seq, fnd10_fund_cd) AS book_id , fnd10_fund_cd AS fund_code , fnd10_fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd10_manage_type AS manage_type FROM ( /*----------- 운용펀드 보유종목 -----------*/ SELECT fnd01_fund_cd AS fnd10_fund_cd , fnd02_fund_nm AS fnd10_fund_nm , '운용' AS fnd10_manage_type , 1 AS seq FROM fnd10_book INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code ON fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd10_fund_code_id INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd10_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd10_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date <= fnd10_std_date ) ) WHERE fnd10_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd10_std_date = #{stdDate} AND fnd10_item_cd = #{itemCode} UNION ALL SELECT fnd11_fund_cd AS fnd10_fund_cd , fnd11_fund_nm AS fnd10_fund_nm , '운용' AS fnd10_manage_type , 1 AS seq FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd11_std_date) FROM fnd11_book_extr WHERE fnd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd11_std_date <= #{stdDate}::date ) AND fnd11_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND fnd11_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) UNION ALL SELECT null AS fnd10_fund_cd , '**펀드자산 보유**' AS fnd10_fund_nm , '운용' AS fnd10_manage_type , 1 AS seq FROM flt09_fund_item WHERE flt09_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt09_std_date = #{stdDate} AND flt09_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND flt09_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) /*----------- 일임/자문 보유종목 -----------*/ UNION ALL SELECT adv10_manage_cd AS fnd10_fund_cd , adv10_manage_nm AS fnd10_fund_nm , '일임/자문' AS fnd10_manage_type , 2 AS seq FROM adv10_book WHERE adv10_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv10_std_date = #{stdDate} AND adv10_item_cd = #{itemCode} UNION ALL SELECT adv11_manage_cd AS fnd10_fund_cd , adv11_manage_nm AS fnd10_fund_nm , '일임/자문' AS fnd10_manage_type , 2 AS seq FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(adv11_std_date) FROM adv11_book_extr WHERE adv11_company_id = #{companyId} AND adv11_std_date <= #{stdDate}::date ) AND adv11_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND adv11_item_type = '2010' --(2010:주식) /*----------- 고유자산 보유종목 -----------*/ UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT null AS fnd10_fund_cd , '**고유자산 보유**' AS fnd10_fund_nm , '고유' AS fnd10_manage_type , 3 AS seq FROM ast09_book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN com50_item ON com50_item_short_cd = ast01_isin AND com50_item_type = '2010' WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_qty != 0 AND com50_item_cd = #{itemCode} AND ast01_asset_type = '1' /*(1:고유자산)*/ AND ast01_item_s_class_cd IN ('201010','201011') /*(201010:상장주식/201011:IPO)*/ AND (ast09_ast_class_tree_id ,ast09_keep_account_id ,ast09_hold_date ) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id , ast09_keep_account_id , MAX(ast09_hold_date) FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_date <= #{stdDate}::date GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) ) t
